title: Concurrent stdin pipe streaming and storage-only susi-distill tag discovery in susi-harness git_governor
goal: Fix >64 KB OS pipe buffer deadlock when git cat-file --batch inspects large .agents/tasks ledgers by streaming stdin concurrently via std::thread::scope in run_git, and teach promote_release_candidate to fetch and audit storage-only refs/tags/susi-distill/* snapshot tags (including legacy-release-* tags after T-CODEXSTORAGEONLY-1) while ranking semver vX.Y.Z candidates ahead of ad-hoc date RCs.
